_readme: Shop catalogue. Prices are in pence (1299 = £12.99). 'stock' is how many you have to sell. 'image' is a product photo path, e.g. "assets/products/cg4829.jpg". 'featured': true shows it under Trending. Add 'compareAt' (a genuine previous price) to show it as on offer. 'hidden': true keeps a product off the shop. 'images' (optional) is a list of extra photos for the product page gallery; the first should match 'image'.
